title: Query a FeatureServer layer with where + outFields
prompt: Write a standalone TypeScript ESM program that queries the Esri GeoServices FeatureServer at the base URL in HONUA_EVAL_BASE_URL: service "EvalIncidents", layer 0, where clause "priority = 'high'", outFields ["OBJECTID", "name", "priority"], without geometry. Use @honua/sdk-js (HonuaClient with { baseUrl }, then featureLayer(service, layer).queryFeatures(...)). Print exactly one line to stdout: a JSON object {"count": <number of returned features>, "firstName": <the name attribute of the first feature>}.

context.notes: Golden workflow: attribute-filtered query with field projection.
